summary: Wraps a memory-block validation under a critical section: a null argument takes a short-circuit path into sub_58A0BF; otherwise the stream buffer at a1 is locked, validated by MemoryBlockValidationCheck, the critical section is released, and the validation result is returned.

operations.description: If argument a1 is zero, skip the lock/validate/unlock path entirely.
sub_58A0BF(0) handles the null case and its result is returned directly.
StreamBufferLockViaCriticalSection(a1) acquires the lock for the stream buffer at a1.
v2 = MemoryBlockValidationCheck(a1) validates the memory block and stores its result.
AddressRangeCriticalSectionLeave(a1) releases the critical section held on a1.

unresolved: Behavior of sub_58A0BF for the null case is unknown.
Semantics of MemoryBlockValidationCheck and the lock protocol pair (StreamBufferLockViaCriticalSection / AddressRangeCriticalSectionLeave) are outside this wrapper.
